description: This file defines the Wrapped class which provides methods to gather various statistics related to notes, organization, and attachments within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for calculating note counts, word counts, organization stats, and attachment info, utilizing database queries and HTML parsing.

classes.name: Wrapped
classes.description: A class that provides methods to compute and retrieve various statistics related to notes, organization, and attachments within the Notesnook application.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves aggregated statistics for notes, organization, and attachments for the current year.

methods.name: getYearRange
methods.description: Calculates the start and end timestamps for the current year.

methods.name: getNoteStats
methods.description: Gathers statistics related to notes, including total count, word count, monographs, and most active days/months.

methods.name: countItemNotes
methods.description: Counts the number of notes associated with each tag or notebook.

methods.name: getOrganizationStats
methods.description: Gathers statistics related to notebooks, tags, colors, and their usage.

methods.name: getAttachmentStats
methods.description: Gathers statistics related to attachments, including total count, storage used, largest attachment, and most common file type.

methods.name: countTotalWords
methods.description: Counts total words across notes and identifies the largest note by word count.
